Package org.apache.cayenne.access

Class DataContextObjectStore

java.lang.Object
org.apache.cayenne.access.DataContextObjectStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectStore
public class DataContextObjectStore extends Object implements ObjectStore
ObjectStore of a DataContext. Stores objects using their ObjectId as a key and keeps their committed snapshots in sync with the shared DataRowStore.
Since:
5.0

    • getCachedSnapshot

      public DataRow getCachedSnapshot(ObjectId oid)
      Returns a snapshot for ObjectId from the underlying snapshot cache, or null if the cache contains no snapshot. Snapshots are keyed by the concrete entity of an object, so an id of a superentity is matched against the ids of its subentities as well. A nested context has no snapshot cache of its own, so it takes the current state of the object in the parent context as the snapshot.
      Specified by:
      getCachedSnapshot in interface ObjectStore

    • getSnapshot

      public DataRow getSnapshot(ObjectId oid)
      Returns a snapshot for ObjectId from the underlying snapshot cache. If the cache contains no snapshot, it is fetched from the database. Returns null if no matching row exists.
      Specified by:
      getSnapshot in interface ObjectStore
      Since:

    • hasChanges

      public boolean hasChanges()
      Returns true if there are any modified, deleted or new objects registered with this ObjectStore, false otherwise. This method will treat "phantom" modifications are real ones. I.e. if you "change" an object property to an equivalent value, this method will still think such object is modified. Phantom modifications are only detected and discarded during commit.
      Specified by:
      hasChanges in interface ObjectStore
